description: This file defines an interface 'RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder' and its nested 'ResponseFactory' interface. It specifies methods for creating responses to retrieve attribute commands, such as returning the attribute value or an error response. It is part of a package related to live signal commands within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder for creating responses to retrieve attribute commands, extending query command response steps.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a response containing the retrieved attribute value, given a JsonValue, for the RetrieveAttribute command.

methods.name: attributeNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the attribute does not exist or access is denied.
